texts.content:
The species Linjealger Nebulon, commonly referred to as “striped algae,” is a gregarious aquatic organism
that inhabits the deep beds of certain large lagoons in Maxkodia. It forms expansive colonies that
visually blend into the environment through tentacle-like appendages which mimic the texture
and movement of native algae and aquatic plants.

This mimicry attracts small benthic creatures that, upon biting the nebulon’s appendages,
are instantly paralyzed. In that brief moment, they are swiftly absorbed by the colony.

No specimen has ever been observed outside the water. Yet their presence is equally
rare on the surface  or during controlled dives, the Linjealger remains hidden, active
only in the deepest, least disturbed zones of the ecosystem.
